'''''Supply''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] retrofitted to be a supply ship that would provide [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] with more [[Warhead/Legends|warheads]] should they run out. The ship was present on the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Garrett (Star Destroyer)|''Garrett'']].

==Behind the scenes==
The transport appears in [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']], battle 13 mission 4, to resupply the player's craft. The game also introduced the [[combat utility vehicle]] for the same purpose.
